items.question: What should one know about all things from supreme-truth determination?
premises: All things are known as equal.
items.inference: Therefore from supreme truth one knows all as equal.
uncertainties: Compound internal analysis follows standard sandhi; no split row used.
items.plain_english: From determination of supreme truth, one should know all as equal.
